name: AI-Powered Resume Creation Suite
description: Enterprise cross-platform resume builder application architecture supporting Web, Mobile (Android/iOS), and Backend REST API with database provisioning and AI enhancements.

web.styling: Vanilla CSS Design System (Custom Tokens, CSS Variables, Glassmorphism, Responsive Grid)
web.pdf_generation: HTML5 Canvas / Window Print Engine & Client-side PDF Renderer
web.state_management: React Context / Hooks with Local Storage Synchronization

mobile.framework: React / PWA / Cross-Platform Mobile Web Architecture
mobile.ui_paradigm: Touch-First Swipeable Wizard Tabs & Action Sheets

server.orm_database_ready: Prisma ORM (Schema ready for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or SQLite)
server.ai_integration: Google Gemini API / OpenAI API / Heuristic NLP Engine fallback
server.cors_policy: Cross-Origin Enabled for Web & Mobile clients

endpoints.description: Health check status of API backend
Update an existing resume record by ID
AI engine endpoint to generate professional summaries based on role and skills
AI engine endpoint to convert simple job descriptions into strong action-verb bullet points
AI engine endpoint to calculate ATS resume score and suggest keyword optimizations

ai_features.name: AI Executive Summary Generator
ai_features.description: Crafts compelling 2-4 sentence professional summaries tailored to target roles.

ai_features.name: Action-Verb Bullet Point Enhancer
ai_features.description: Transforms plain job responsibilities into quantified achievement-driven statements.

ai_features.name: Skill Recommender Engine
ai_features.description: Predicts missing high-demand technical and soft skills based on job title.

ai_features.name: ATS Compatibility Inspector
ai_features.description: Scans resume structure, keywords, and density to provide an ATS score out of 100 with recommendations.

templates.name: Modern Minimalist
templates.description: Clean single-column layout with sleek typography and subtle accent borders.

templates.name: Executive Split Column
templates.description: Two-column layout separating contact/skills from core work experience.

templates.name: Tech Innovator
templates.description: Dark-accented modern layout tailored for developers and product designers.
